source:
erDiagram
  SINGLE_ENTITY { string id PK string label }

flowchart LR
  A[사용자 요청] --> B{권한 확인}
  B -->|허용| C[안전한 렌더]
  B -->|거부| D[설명 반환]

flowchart TD
  A[This node deliberately contains a long descriptive label that should wrap without overlapping adjacent nodes] --> B[Second node with another intentionally verbose description]
  B --> C[Result]

flowchart LR
  subgraph Client
    A[Browser] --> B[UI]
  end
  subgraph Service
    C[API] --> D[Worker]
  end
  B --> C
  D --> E[(Store)]

flowchart TB
  subgraph Platform
    subgraph Control
      A[Gateway] --> B[Policy]
    end
    subgraph Data
      C[(Primary DB)] --> D[Replica]
    end
  end
  B --> C
  D --> E[Analytics]

flowchart LR
  A --> B & C & D
  B --> E & F
  C --> E & G
  D --> F & G
  E --> H
  F --> H
  G --> H

flowchart TD
  A([Start]) --> B[/Input/] --> C{Valid?}
  C -->|yes| D[[Subroutine]] --> E[(Database)]
  C -->|no| F>Manual review] --> G([Stop])

flowchart TB
  A[Request] --> B[Validate]
  B --> C[Enqueue email]
  B --> D[Enqueue audit]
  B --> E[Update cache]
  C --> F[Done]
  D --> F
  E --> F

flowchart LR
  A[Draft] --> B[Review] --> C[Approved]
  B --> D[Changes requested]
  D --> A
  C --> E[Published]

flowchart TD
  A[Text: colon, comma, slash / and parentheses] --> B[Safe punctuation]
  B --> C[Rendered]

sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant A as API
  participant W as Worker
  U->>A: submit request
  A->>W: enqueue job
  W-->>A: accepted
  A-->>U: 202 Accepted

sequenceDiagram participant Client participant Gateway participant Service Client->>Gateway: first line
second line
third line Gateway->>Service: validate payload Service-->>Gateway: result Gateway-->>Client: response

sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant S as Service
  alt authorized
    C->>S: request
    S-->>C: data
  else unauthorized
    C->>S: request
    S-->>C: error
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant A
  participant B
  participant C
  par background jobs
    A->>B: task one
  and
    A->>C: task two
  end
  B-->>A: complete
  C-->>A: complete

sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant S as Service
  C->>+S: begin
  S->>S: compute
  S-->>-C: finish

sequenceDiagram
  participant P1
  participant P2
  participant P3
  participant P4
  participant P5
  participant P6
  participant P7
  participant P8
  P1->>P2: one
  P2->>P3: two
  P3->>P4: three
  P4->>P5: four
  P5->>P6: five
  P6->>P7: six
  P7->>P8: seven

sequenceDiagram
  participant 사용자
  participant 서버
  participant 저장소
  사용자->>서버: 주문 생성
  서버->>저장소: 재고 확인
  저장소-->>서버: 가능
  서버-->>사용자: 완료

sequenceDiagram
  participant Scheduler
  participant Worker
  loop each pending task
    Scheduler->>Worker: dispatch
    Worker-->>Scheduler: acknowledgement
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Browser
  participant API
  Note over Browser,API: Request must remain bounded
  Browser->>API: fetch summary
  API-->>Browser: summary

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Draft
  Draft --> Review
  Review --> Published
  Published --> [*]

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Active
  state Active {
    [*] --> Loading
    Loading --> Ready
    Ready --> Loading: refresh
  }
  Active --> [*]

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Validate
  Validate --> Decision
  state Decision <<choice>>
  Decision --> Accepted: valid
  Decision --> Rejected: invalid
  Accepted --> [*]
  Rejected --> [*]

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Fork
  state Fork <<fork>>
  Fork --> One
  Fork --> Two
  One --> Join
  Two --> Join
  state Join <<join>>
  Join --> [*]

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> 초안
  초안 --> 검토중
  검토중 --> 게시됨: 승인
  검토중 --> 초안: 수정
  게시됨 --> [*]

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> WaitingForExternalConfirmationFromTheLongRunningBackgroundOperation
  WaitingForExternalConfirmationFromTheLongRunningBackgroundOperation --> CompletedSuccessfully
  CompletedSuccessfully --> [*]

stateDiagram-v2
  state Processing {
    [*] --> Receive
    Receive --> Transform
    Transform --> Persist
  }
  [*] --> Processing
  Processing --> Failed
  Processing --> Completed
  Failed --> [*]
  Completed --> [*]

flowchart TB
  A[High contrast semantic content] --> B{Decision}
  B -->|affirmative| C[Clearly named success outcome]
  B -->|negative| D[Clearly named error outcome]

flowchart LR
  A[Connected start] --> B[Connected finish]
  C[Disconnected component one]
  D[Disconnected component two]

sequenceDiagram
  participant UI
  participant API
  participant Auth
  participant DB
  participant Queue
  participant Email
  UI->>API: submit
  API->>Auth: authorize
  Auth-->>API: allow
  API->>DB: write
  DB-->>API: committed
  API->>Queue: publish
  Queue->>Email: deliver
  Email-->>Queue: accepted
  API-->>UI: success
